author: nixo.eth
content: This channel is being opened as a discussion venue for an EIP being proposed for the Hegotá upgrade. Issuance curve changes are a heavily contentious topic - as a result, this channel will be more rigorously moderated than usual: please keep discussion civil, research-oriented, and on-topic. This server is strictly for R&D. Users engaging in anything remotely resembling personal attacks, overly aggressive messages, or brigading will be timed out.
